business_summary: Chongqing Water Group Co.,Ltd. engages in water supply, wastewater treatment, sludge treatment and disposal, engineering construction, and other businesses in China. The company is also involved in the production and supply of tap water; sewage water treatment; and recycled water. It operates and manages tap water and sewage treatment plants. In addition, the company engages in municipal public works; building construction; water conservancy and hydroelectric engineering; electromechanical engineering and other engineering construction; environmental pollution control, construction engineering and municipal public engineering supervision; and manufacture of water supply and drainage equipment. Further, it sells materials; and installs pipeline and water meters, etc. Additionally, the company collects physical, chemical, and biochemical treatment of domestic and industrial sewage, initial rainwater, and other wastewater, ensuring compliance with national environmental standards before discharge; manages wet sludge generated from urban wastewater treatment plants, utilizing aerobic fermentation, co-firing, combined heat and power, and thermal drying to achieve reduction, stabilization, and harmlessness. The company was formerly known as Chongqing Water Holding (Group) Co., Ltd. Chongqing Water Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is based in Chongqing, China. Chongqing Water Group Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Chongqing Derun Environment Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: 충칭수그룹유한회사 중국에서 물 공급, 폐수 처리, 슬러지 처리 및 처리, 엔지니어링 건설 및 기타 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 수돗물 생산 및 공급에도 참여하고 있습니다. 하수 처리; 그리고 재활용된 물. 수돗물과 하수처리장을 운영, 관리합니다. 또한 회사는 지방자치단체의 공공사업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 건물 건설; 수자원 보존 및 수력 전기 공학; 전기 기계 공학 및 기타 공학 건설; 환경 오염 통제, 건설 엔지니어링 및 도시 공공 엔지니어링 감독; 급배수 장비 제조. 또한 재료를 판매합니다. 또한, 회사는 생활 및 산업 하수, 초기 빗물, 기타 폐수를 물리적, 화학적, 생화학적 처리수를 수집하여 배출 전 국가 환경 기준을 준수합니다. 도시폐수처리장에서 발생하는 습성슬러지를 호기발효, 혼소, 열병합발전, 열건조 등을 활용하여 저감, 안정화를 달성하는 슬러지를 관리합니다.
